reading: An all-background grid gets its outer border painted 8; the interior stays 0.

new_rows.name: grid_edge
new_rows.datalog:
hmax(max(Y)) :- px(Y, X, C).
wmax(max(X)) :- px(Y, X, C).
grid_edge(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), Y = 0.
grid_edge(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), X = 0.
grid_edge(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), hmax(H), Y = H.
grid_edge(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), wmax(W), X = W.

why: every border cell of the output is 8 and every interior cell is unchanged (0)

reading: The leading colours on the middle row form a cycle; the cycle is continued along the row with copies placed at triangular-number columns 0,1,3,6,10,15,21,28,...

slots.cycle: the run of non-zero colours at the left end of the middle row, in order
slots.positions: columns k(k+1)/2 for k=0,1,2,... while inside the grid

why: each non-zero cell of the output row sits at a triangular column and carries the cycle colour of its index; all other cells are 0

reading: A horizontal line of 1s contains special cells 8 and 2; above each special cell a vertical stalk grows upward: two 1s then an 8 for an 8, three 1s then a 2 for a 2.

slots.line: the one row of 1s with embedded special cells
slots.sources: the non-1 cells in that line
slots.length: colour-dependent: 8 -> 3 cells, 2 -> 4 cells above the line

why: for every special cell, the cells directly above it are line-colour for length-1 cells and the source colour at the tip; nothing else changes
invariants: all cells not above a special cell

reading: Every 4 falls one row; a 4 that lands directly above the full 2-line shoots diagonal 4-rays up-left and up-right to the grid edge.

slots.subject: all 4 cells (including any below the line)
slots.trigger: a moved 4 whose new row is the row just above the 2 separator
slots.rays: two diagonals of 4 from the trigger cell going up-left and up-right until the border

why: each output 4 is either an input 4 shifted down one row or on an up-diagonal from a shifted 4 that touches the 2-line; the 2-line is unchanged

reading: A top bar and a bottom bar sit on either side of a full 2-row; in the columns where both bars have cells, the gap between the separator and the longer bar is filled with 4.

new_rows.name: overlap_side
new_rows.datalog:
sep(Y) :- cell(Y, X, C), C = 2.
topx(X) :- cell(Y, X, C), sep(S), Y < S.
botx(X) :- cell(Y, X, C), sep(S), Y > S.
topy(Y) :- cell(Y, X, C), sep(S), Y < S.
boty(Y) :- cell(Y, X, C), sep(S), Y > S.
ntop(count(X)) :- topx(X).
nbot(count(X)) :- botx(X).
overlap_side(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), topx(X), botx(X), ntop(A), nbot(B), A > B, topy(T), sep(S), Y > T, Y < S.
overlap_side(Y, X) :- px(Y, X, C), topx(X), botx(X), ntop(A), nbot(B), A < B, boty(T), sep(S), Y > S, Y < T.

why: the only changed cells are 4s in the shared columns of the two bars, strictly between the longer bar and the separator
invariants: the half next to the shorter bar

reading: A staircase line of 2s crosses the grid; in each column everything above the 2s becomes 0 and everything below becomes the scatter colour; a column with no 2 becomes all 0.

slots.line: the 2 cells (topmost and bottommost 2 per column)
slots.above: cells above the column's top 2 (or the whole column if it has no 2) -> 0
slots.below: cells below the column's bottom 2 -> the other foreground colour (1/5/8)

why: per column: 0 above the line, line kept, solid foreground colour below

reading: Several V-shaped 2 cups have gaps between their arms; the loose 9s are removed and used to fill the gaps of the one cup whose gap count equals the number of 9s.

slots.capacity: background cells between two 2 cells on the same row inside a cup
slots.target: the cup whose capacity equals the count of 9s; its gap cells become 9

why: number of 9s is preserved; all 9s end inside exactly one cup's between-cells, filling it completely
invariants: background except removed 9s and filled gaps

reading: A 7x7 panel of 1s carries four colour marks at (1,1),(1,5),(5,1),(5,5); the output is that panel with 1s turned to 0 and each mark replaced by the 3x3 shape of the same colour found elsewhere (shapes of other colours are ignored).

slots.key: the 7x7 rectangle of 1s with coloured marks
slots.pieces: the 3x3-box single-colour shapes outside the key
slots.placement: each piece's 3x3 box centred on the key mark of its colour

why: output = key box; each 3x3 block around a mark equals the box of the same-coloured piece; everything else 0
invariants: relative quadrant layout from the key

reading: Bands of 8 (2 cells thick, separated by 0 lines) contain one 6 block; 8 cells stay 8 only inside a bow-tie spreading from the 6 block across bands (the 6's own band stays whole, the next band keeps only the 6's span, and each further band keeps 2 more cells on each side); all other 8s become 4.

slots.bands: the 2-thick stripes of 8 (rows or columns, whichever direction the 0 separator lines run)
slots.kept: in band at distance d>=1 from the 6 band, cells within the 6 span widened by 2(d-1) on each side; the 6 band entirely

why: only 8 cells change, always to 4, exactly outside the bow-tie; 0 and 6 cells never change

reading: A framed key line lists colours at regular positions; a parallel line of marks outside is compared position by position: a mark matching the key moves to the cell next to the frame, a non-matching mark moves to the opposite grid edge.

slots.key: the colour cells on the line just inside the frame
slots.marks: the loose coloured cells on a parallel line outside the frame
slots.match: mark colour equals key colour at the same position
slots.target: match -> cell adjacent to the frame; mismatch -> the far grid border, same row/column

why: each mark keeps its colour and its coordinate along the line; only its distance from the frame changes, decided by the match
